The design recalls California in the 1970s, where the Pacific breeze mingled with the heat of transistors and disco grooves resonated with the pulse of binary code. In garages, scattered schematics mapped out drafts that would change the world, and the future was already awakening in the golden afterglow of sunset.
Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, the case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture. It is light and strong, and a pleasure to hold every single time.
A sleek, barely-there profile preserves your phone's original feel, ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection without added weight.
